text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The grand finale to close out the year, the Arima Kinen.
The most popular Umamusume, chosen by the fans, have all gathered here.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: So many of you have been waiting to see these two race! Sisters Biwa Hayahide and Narita Brian are both here!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
what do you think strength is?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Is it possessing unmatched strength that none can rival?
Or having an unyielding spirit, unshaken by anything?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I thought it meant being able to stand back up.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Even if I cannot gain power,
even if my heart were to break once.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Whether you're content to just stay sitting down,
or have the will to stand back up.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I want to stand on these two legs like my predecessors and be able to walk wherever I wish.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Not behind me, and not ahead of me.
You stay right beside me and watch.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: And let us walk the same path.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'm counting on you today, Sis.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa~...!
Maya's heart is starting to race, somehow...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya wants to sparkle brightly,
just like those two...!
